scope: Independent direct NPZ/JSON and NumPy FP32 reconstruction of actual frozen research outcomes, not reuse of producer/analyzer judgment. No learner import, source/plan edits, GPU/network call or reselection.
training_error_scope: Only reported training counts and range are verified; training predictions are not saved.
statistics_scope: Approximate Student t intervals over eleven draw accuracies or paired draw differences, conditional on the fixed MNIST pool and frozen procedures. These are not 110000 independent Bernoulli trials, official D6 three-run qualification or a universal accuracy ceiling.
timing_scope: Cumulative synchronized fit/inference plus probability accumulation and member/prefix argmax; excludes input preparation, warmup, truth scoring and evidence serialization. No canonical latency/energy claim.
research_source_scope: Tuple-returning _predict research entries only. Matched-control source is 25474 bytes, above the 20480 byte official cap; it remains unchanged as a research control.
archive_path_scope: Raw paths and file hashes describe observed storage at audit time. Payload SHA is the invariant identity if records are later losslessly gzip-archived.
